text.en:
Dealing <arc/>Arc Damage charges 'Arc Alignment'. 

Energy is granted by the following on a per-hit basis:
• Pulse Rifle Mode: 3%
• Trace Rifle Mode: 1% 
• All other <arc/>Arc-damage sources: 1%

At full energy, hold [Reload] to enter Arc Alignment. Doing so instantly <title refills [G_refill] /> the magazine and grants 75% reduced recoil. 

Arc Alignment energy drains at a rate of 14% per second, and causes hip-fired shots to apply <arc/>Jolt. Aiming Down Sights reduces energy drain by 67%, down to 4.62% per second.
